ruler_basis: pinned by the guide when its draft was extracted; every build on this guide measures with it

layout_defaults_taken: root: ['title', 'lead', 'rows', 'close'] carry no weight: each that is flexible (not sized by its own content) takes an equal share in the split of the free column space
rows: ['epi-row', 'us-row', 'ny-row'] carry no weight: each that is flexible (not sized by its own content) takes an equal share in the split of the free column space
epi-row: ['epi-icon', 'epi-rule'] carry no weight: each that is flexible (not sized by its own content) takes weight 1 against its siblings' weights in the split of the free row space
us-row: ['us-icon', 'us-rule'] carry no weight: each that is flexible (not sized by its own content) takes weight 1 against its siblings' weights in the split of the free row space
ny-row: ['ny-icon', 'ny-rule'] carry no weight: each that is flexible (not sized by its own content) takes weight 1 against its siblings' weights in the split of the free row space

density.covered_basis: ink: each measured text line at its width and pitch, each table at its fitted rows, each chart, image and fill at its box, unioned; a text box stretched past its lines is not covered. The reference band unions the reference's shape boxes, which count a stretched box whole, so the band is the more generous

what_to_do.distinctive: a name, phrase or figure of the past deck found on no public deck of another firm: remove it, or confirm the user supplied it (pass their brief and data with --brief and it is not listed)
what_to_do.low: a term of the trade, a round figure or a year: carry-over only if it came from the past deck rather than from your data; keep each one your data or brief produces, and check any figure you did not compute

leakage.rarity_basis: 13 public decks of other firms in $SKILL/refs/files
leakage.images_checked: pptx media by sha256; a PDF's pictures are not checked
leakage.method: names (2+ capitalised words), figures and 5-word phrases of each new page found on a past page; chrome (on 50%+ of a past deck's pages), template text and --brief text excluded; thresholds unmeasured
leakage.verdict: possible carry-over: 194 distinctive finding(s): remove each, or confirm the user supplied it for this deck
